test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Koushik said to Tarun, "You are a good cricketer."

options.text: Koushik told Tarun that he had been a good cricketer.
Koushik told Tarun that he was a good cricketer.
Koushik tells Tarun that he is a good cricketer.
Koushik told that Tarun is a good cricketer.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Koushik told Tarun that he was a good cricketer.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"You are a good cricketer" becomes "he was a good cricketer"**
 
 
• The pronoun "you" is changed to "he" to match the indirect speech context.
 
• The verb "are" is changed to "was" to match the past tense in reported speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "said to"
 
• Indirect: "told"
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• In reported speech, quotation marks are not used.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Koushik told Tarun that he was a good cricketer."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Koushik told Tarun that he had been a good cricketer." 

 
 
• Incorrect past perfect tense changes the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Koushik tells Tarun that he is a good cricketer." 
 
 
• Incorrect present tense used in the reporting verb.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Koushik told that Tarun is a good cricketer." 
 
 
• Incorrect structure; "that" should refer to the statement about Tarun.
